data.title: Liberty Group 2026 meeting resolutions all passed
data.description:
An update from Liberty Financial Group Ltd ( (AU:LFG) ) is now available.

Liberty Financial Group said all resolutions at its 19 November 2026 annual general meeting and the Liberty Financial Group Trust unitholders’ general meeting were passed by poll. The resolutions included a non-binding advisory vote on the remuneration report and the re-election of Leona Murphy.

Meeting participants also approved MTI and LTI awards for James Boyle, Peter Riedel and Sherman Ma. The resolutions passed with votes in favour ranging from 99.24% to 99.99%, according to the meeting results.

data.title: NH Investment & Securities Files KRW 62 Billion ELS Documents
data.description:
NH INVESTMENT & SECURITIES CO.LTD. ( (KR:005940) ) just unveiled an update.

NH Investment & Securities filed additional documents covering eight equity-linked securities series with a combined total amount offered or sold of KRW 62 billion. The disclosed series reference Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, KOSPI200, S&P500, NIKKEI225, Tesla and Advanced Micro Devices, with stepdown structures and maturities in November 2029.

Under the universal registration statement, the planned issuance amount was KRW 10 trillion, while total offerings or sales during the issuance period reached KRW 8.255 trillion and actual issuance amounted to KRW 2.943 trillion. The products are classified as high-risk investments, are not covered by depositor protection, and may result in losses of up to 100% of principal; the stated target market has high investment knowledge, loss tolerance and risk-seeking profiles.

data.title: Adore Beauty reports all AGM resolutions passed
data.description:
Adore Beauty Group Ltd. ( (AU:ABY) ) has provided an announcement.

Adore Beauty Group is a beauty, lifestyle and wellness retailer operating in Australia and New Zealand, with an integrated omni-channel model combining its online platform and national retail-store network. The group includes Adore Beauty, an e-commerce destination, and iKOU, a wellness and beauty brand, offering more than 300 brands and 15,000 products.

At its 19 November 2026 annual general meeting, all resolutions passed by the requisite majority through a poll. The re-election of Lisa Hennessy and the remuneration report were both carried, receiving 99.79% and 99.26% support respectively in the poll.
